ns2:course.label: Perf Pract November I
ns2:course.description: Performance laboratory involving the rehearsal and performance of works by faculty and visiting artists performed in November Dance. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. A maximum of 16 hours of performance credit may be counted toward degree requirements.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. A maximum of 16 hours of performance credit may be counted toward degree requirements.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s). Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
